Step 1: Calculate after-tax cash (30% tax)

- North: Salary $155,000, bonus 0% = $0
  Taxable = $155,000
  After-tax = $155,000 × 0.70 = $108,500

- South: Salary $155,000, bonus 15% = 0.15 × $155,000 = $23,250
  Taxable = $155,000 + $23,250 = $178,250
  After-tax = $178,250 × 0.70 = $124,775

Step 2: Calculate retirement match (not taxed)

- North: 5% × $155,000 = $7,750, capped at $6,000 → $6,000
- South: 3% × $155,000 = $4,650, capped at $20,000 → $4,650

Step 3: Calculate equity vested by end of month 12

- North: $80,000 over 4 years with 1-year cliff. First 25% vests at month 12: $80,000 / 4 = $20,000
- South: $80,000 over 4 years monthly. By month 12: 12/48 × $80,000 = $20,000

Step 4: Total first-year value

- North: $108,500 + $6,000 + $20,000 = $134,500
- South: $124,775 + $4,650 + $20,000 = $149,425

South has the higher first-year value.
